諾言; keep a promise: 信守承諾

turns.t: I need someone to help me with a few legal matters.
Why don't you consult Mr. Miller? He is quite an expert.
I'll call his office now.

questions.explain:

information or advice from a person, book, etc. with special knowledge on a
particular subject諮詢；請教; expert: a person with a high level of
knowledge or skill relating to a particular subject or activity專家; lawyer n. 律
師 ; accountant n. 會計師; priest. n.神父，牧師

options.B: She didn't wake up in time.

questions.explain:
解析: fail her math test 她的數學考試不及格; stayed up all night熬夜
She was so tired that she didn't hear her alarm clock.(她是太疲倦，以至於沒
有
聽到鬧鐘。) 所以答案 b　She didn't wake up in time. 她沒有及時醒來。
fail (v.) to be unsuccessful, or to judge that someone has been unsuccessful,
in a test or exam（使）不及格；（使）未能通過（考試）
A lot of people fail their driving test the first time.

questions.stem: M: I need to buy a new pair of sneakers. W: Fine. I'm going to look at women's clothing. M: I'll meet you at the Japanese restaurant on the top floor in half an hour. Q: Where are the speakers?

turns.t: I need to buy a new pair of sneakers.
Fine. I'm going to look at women's clothing.
I'll meet you at the Japanese restaurant on the top floor in half an hour.

questions.explain:
解析: sneaker: a type of light, comfortable shoe that is suitable for playing
sports 運動鞋; department store: 百貨公司

options.B: She had to visit her parents.

Sorry, Jack. I had to take my son to a clinic.
I am sorry to hear that. Is he OK?

questions.explain:

turns.t: I think this one matches your shirt and suit.
Are you sure? It seems too bright.
That's the fashion this season.
All right. And I'll need a pin to go with it.

questions.explain:

questions.stem: _______ I agree with you, it does not necessarily mean that I'll support you.
questions.explain:
解析: 句意_______我同意你的意見，但這不一定意味著我會支持你的。 a
unless _除非 b. Whether無論 c. Until 直到d. While 儘管 依照句意答案選 d

questions.stem: Let's go grab a bite to eat before the movie, _______
questions.explain:
解析: 句意我們看電影前去吃點東⻄吧，_______？ 特殊附加問句 ① Let's ...
, shall we ? ② Let's not ... , all right /OK ? 　③ 祈使句... , will you ? (否定也
是用will you ) ④ 邀請 , won't you ?

questions.stem: The patient is suffering from a _______ disease and only has weeks to live.
questions.explain:
解析: 句意 該患者患有_______疾病，只能存活數週。依照句意 答案a
terminal末期的 Terminal (adj.) (of a disease or illness) leading gradually to
death （疾病）晚期的，末期的 They didn't realize his cancer was terminal.

questions.stem: The huge traffic jam _______ the road system in the city for more than 3 hours.
questions.explain:
解析: 句意巨大的交通擁堵使該市的道路系統_______了3個多小時。依照句
意 答案b paralyzed 癱瘓的 Paralyze (v.) unable to move or act 麻痺的，癱瘓
的 The accident left her paralysed from the waist down.

questions.stem: Take a deep breath, George. You are _______ too nervous now.
questions.explain:
解析: 句意 深吸一口氣，喬治。您現在_______太緊張了。 「主詞 + be動詞
+ being + 形容詞」的句型是用來指某人只是在此刻或過去的某一刻是那樣子
注意主詞後的 be 動詞要視時態而用 am, are, is 或過去的 was, were

questions.stem: You must _______ your cigarette in the special container outside the restaurant before going back inside.
questions.explain:
解析:句意 您必須先在餐廳外的專用容器中_______抽煙，然後再返回店內。
a distinguish區分 b. resist 抵抗 c. extinguish熄滅 d. consist組成 依照句意答
案選 c Extinguish (v.) to stop a fire or a light burning 熄滅，撲滅（火或光）
It took the firefighters several hours to extinguish the flames.

questions.stem: The pedestrian _______ down by a van has been rushed to a nearby hospital.
questions.explain:
解析: 這裡選run 是過去分詞表示被動-� 原句子 the pedestrian who was run
down by…..-�who was 省略。句子意思:被貨車撞倒的行人已被送往附近的醫
院。

questions.stem: The war hero survived the war, _______ die in a car accident on his way home.
questions.explain:
解析: 句意這位戰爭英雄在戰爭中倖存下來，在回家途中因車禍喪生
_______。only to + 原形動詞常常充當結果副詞, 它所表示的事件是緊接在前
面的事件之後發生的, 往往表示意外或不幸的結果。

questions.stem: David went through a three-month trial period before he was offered a _______ job.
questions.explain:
解析: 句意大衛經歷了三個月的試用期，然後才被提供_______的工作。
logical 合乎邏輯的 b. preventive預防性的 c. likely可能的 d. permanent永久的
依照句意答案選 d trial (n.) a test, usually over a limited period of time, to
discover how effective or suitable something or someone is 試驗；試用
They've employed her for a six-month trial period. permanent (adj.) lasting
or continuing for a very long time or forever The museum's permanent
collection includes works of art from the 18th century.

questions.stem: Listen, you guys. A prize of $200 will go to _______ tells the best joke.
questions.explain:
解析: whoever = any one who，複合關係代名詞 whoever 結合先行詞 any
one 與關係代名詞 who。複合關係代名詞含有先行詞與關係代名詞雙重角
色。使用複合關係代名詞不需要先行詞。

questions.stem: Doing anything _______ is likely to invite trouble. You should always look before you leap.
questions.explain:
解析: 句意________做任何事情都可能引起麻煩。 你應該總是在跳之前先看
一下。 a. consequently 因此 b. relatively 相對地 c. consciously 有意識地 d.
recklessly魯莽地。依照句意答案選 d Recklessly (adv.) marked by lack of
proper caution: careless of consequences魯莽地 They recklessly threw
themselves into battle.

questions.stem: Some people believe there is a(n) _______ force in the Bermuda Triangle that pulls pilots off their courses.
questions.explain:
解析: 句意 有人認為，百慕大三角地區有一________力量將飛行員拖離航
道。 依照句意答案選 b mysterious 難以理解的 Mysterious (adj.) strange, not
known, or not understood 神秘的事物，難以理解的事物，謎 He died in
mysterious circumstances, and there is still a possibility that it was murder.

questions.stem: Donald Trump was the first president in US history to be _______ twice.
questions.explain:
解析: 句意唐納德·特朗普（Donald Trump）是美國歷史上第一位_____兩次
總統。a. grazed 吃草的 b. impeached彈劾 c. generated產生的d. prepared
準備好的 依照句意答案選 b Impeach (v.) to charge (a public official) with a
crime done while in office 彈劾 Congress will vote on whether or not to
impeach the President.

questions.stem: The terrorist tried to _______ the airplane but was subdued on board by an undercover cop.
questions.explain:
解析: 句意 恐怖分子試圖_______飛機，但被一名臥底警察制服。
a. persuade 說服 b. hire聘請 c. collide碰撞 d. hijack劫持
依照句意答案選 d
hijack (v.) to take control of an aircraft or other vehicle during a journey,
especially using violence 劫持（飛機或車輛）
Two men hijacked a jet travelling to Paris and demanded $125,000.

questions.stem: I stayed in Paris for five years, during _______ time I studied the French language and culture.
questions.explain:
解析: 句意我在巴黎待了五年，在那期間我學習了法語和文化。 關係代名詞
which是代替前面整個主要子句内容的，因此 which子句做修飾句子的形容詞
子句，上句的難點在於：which在子句中不是作主詞或受詞，也不是作介係詞
受詞，而是作形容詞。因此，可以把 which叫做關係形容詞或關係限定詞
（relative determiner）。

questions.stem: In the early days of the 20th century, almost all photographers _______ professionals.
questions.explain:
解析: 句意在20世紀初期，幾乎所有攝影師都是_______專業人士。 過去簡單
式可用來表示過去的事實或普遍性真理 (但現在已不存在) 依照句意答案選 b
Professional (n.) a person who has the type of job that needs a high level of
education and training 專業人員 Will healthcare professionals risk their
licenses if they assist a woman?

questions.stem: Mandy _______ her mother in looks and personality.
questions.explain:
解析: 依照句意答案a take after : to be similar to an older member of your
family in appearance or character （在外貌、性格等方面）與（家庭中某個
年紀較大成員）相像

questions.stem: Fatigue from overwork and lack of sleep can severely decrease our work _______ and performance.
questions.explain:
解析: 句意 過度勞累和缺乏睡眠造成的疲勞會嚴重降低我們的工作_____和表
現。依照句意答案選 a efficiency 效率 Efficiency (n.) the good use of time
and energy in a way that does not waste any 效率；效能；功效 What is so
impressive about their society is the efficiency of the public services.

questions.stem: My colleague suggested that we _______ at some other places for a change.
questions.explain:
解析:英文中要表示「建議、堅持或要求某人事物做某某動作」會應用一種句
型：動詞 + that + 主詞 + (should) + 動詞，其中助動詞 should 可以省略，不
過就算省略之後，其後的動詞仍然要維持原本原形動詞的型態喔！因此就算
that 這個子句裡的主詞為第三人稱單數 my colleague，後面的動詞仍然要用
原形。答案a

questions.stem: Except for a few occasions, motorists are not allowed to use the _______ on the highway.
questions.explain:
解析: 句意除少數情況外，不允許駕駛員在高速公路上使用_______。 依照句
意答案選 d shoulder 路肩 Shoulder (n.) an area along the side of a main
road where cars can stop 路肩，（大路兩側的）緊急停車道 There were tire
tracks left in the soft shoulder

questions.stem: A flashlight, a first aid kit, a pocket knife, and other gadgets will come in _______ when you go camping in the mountains.
questions.explain:
解析: 句意當您在山上露營時，手電筒，急救箱，小刀和其他小工具會派上用
場。 Handy (adj.) very useful or helpful便利 The extra batteries for the
flashlight came in handy when the electricity went off.

questions.stem: We wish the bride and the bridegroom _______.
questions.explain: 解析: wish + 某人 ＋ 某事 答案d

questions.stem: All things _______, I think we should take the initiative.
questions.explain:
解析: 句意 考慮到所有事情，我認為我們應該採取主動。 all things
considered 這是一個固定用法，表示「考慮到所有的因素；總體來說」。
Initiative (n.) a new plan or process to achieve something or solve a problem
倡議；新措施 The peace initiative was welcomed by both sides.

questions.stem: The COVID-19 _______ has lasted more than a year so far.
questions.explain:
解析: 句意 迄今為止，COVID-19________已經持續了一年多。 a. patronage
惠顧 b. version版本 c. pandemic 大流行病 d. virtue 美德 依照句意答案選 c
Pandemic (adj.) (of a disease) existing in almost all of an area or in almost
all of a group of people, animals, or plants （疾病）大規模流行的，廣泛蔓延
的 In some parts of the world malaria is still pandemic.

questions.stem: There will _______ no additional charges for our delivery service.
questions.explain:
解析: 句意我們的送貨服務不會_______收取額外費用。依照句意 答案選b 想
要表達「現在哪裡有某人、事、物」時，英文是用 There is 或 There are 開
頭，至於要用 is 或 are，則取決於後面加的人事物。這裡因為是There will 所
以用原型be Additional (adj.) extra 外加的，額外的 There will be an extra
charge for any additional passengers. Charge (n.) the amount of money that
you have to pay for something, especially for an activity or service （尤指某
一活動或服務的）收費，費用，價格 Is there a charge for children or do they
go free?

questions.stem: You shouldn't _______ Eva's silence as a sign of weakness. She's not afraid to voice her opinion.
questions.explain:
解析: 句意 您不應該________伊娃的沉默表示軟弱。她不怕發表意見。 依照
句意答案選 a interpret闡釋 Interpret (v.) to decide what the intended
meaning of something is 理解，解釋，闡釋 It's difficult to interpret these
statistics without knowing how they were obtained.

questions.stem: People who _______ a lot of red meat tend to have higher blood pressure and cholesterol levels.
questions.explain:
解析: 句意_______紅肉的人往往有較高的血壓和膽固醇 a. consume 消耗 b.
deny 否定 c. commute通勤 d. delete 刪除 依照句意答案選 a Consume (v.) to
eat or drink (something) They consumed a lot of beer at the party.

questions.stem: At the end of the ceremony, the graduates _______ their caps into the air.
questions.explain:
解析:句意典禮結束時，畢業生_______帽子向空中。依照句意 答案選a a.
threw 扔 b. swiped刷 c. drew畫 d. claimed聲稱

questions.stem: _______ as I sympathize with those earthquake victims, I'm not able to offer much help.
questions.explain:
解析: 句意 我對那些地震受害者深表同情，但我無法提供太多幫助。much as
S + V, S + V. 為連接詞，連接兩個完整子句(有主詞有動詞)，表示「儘管、雖
然」。 引導的子句可置於主要子句之前或之後，中間用逗點隔開。 皆不可再
加連接詞but。 Sympathize (v.) to understand and care about someone's
problems 同情，體諒，憐憫 I know what it's like to have migraines, so I
really sympathize (with you).

questions.stem: By the time we meet again, spring _______.
questions.explain:
解析: 句意 到我們再次見面的時候，春天_______。 By the time 是指
「到……的時候」的意思。[ By the time ]是連接詞，假如它引導的子句是描
述未來，主要子句要用未來完成式。依照句意答案選 d

questions.stem: According to a study, walking _______ has some health benefits. It lets us connect to the Earth and its magnetic fields.
questions.explain:
解析: 句意 一項研究表明，_______走有一定的健康益處。它使我們可以連接
到地球及其磁場。依照句意答案選 a Barefoot 赤腳的（地） Barefoot (adj.)
not wearing any shoes or socks 赤腳的（地） We took off our shoes and
socks and walked barefoot along the beach.

questions.stem: Since the invention of the television and the internet, fewer and fewer people have been listening to the radio. Nevertheless, it has remained an important source of information and entertainment for some people. And of late, a new form of radio show has really taken off ─ the podcast. Podcasts are essentially online radio shows that you can access on your mobile device or computer. The new term is a combination of the words “ipod” and “broadcast.” They can either be downloaded as an audio file or streamed directly on the internet. Which of the following can you use to access a podcast?
questions.explain: 解析: 題目問您可以使用以下哪項可以使用播客？依照句意 答案b

questions.stem: These days, one's temperature can be taken by some new devices that are accurate and easy to use. One such device is known as an infrared thermometer. It should be held close to, but not touch, a person's forehead. The infrared thermometer provides a digital readout of the person's temperature. Another device is an infrared sensor. This is a much larger device that can measure temperature from a distance of several meters. A person's image can be seen on a screen. Unlike the mercury thermometer, both of the devices are non-invasive. Which of the following statements is true about infrared thermometers and infrared sensors?

options.A: Infrared sensors are less expensive than infrared thermometers.
options.B: Infrared sensors are hand-held, while infrared thermometers are not
options.C: Neither infrared thermometers nor infrared sensors have to come into contact with a person’s skin.
options.D: Both infrared thermometers and infrared sensors use colors to display a person's temperature.

questions.explain:
解析: 題目問關於紅外線溫度計和紅外線傳感器，以下哪項是正確的？依照 文
中 “與水銀溫度計不同，這兩種設備都是非侵入性的。” 答案c Neither
infrared thermometers nor infrared sensors have to come into contact with a
person’s skin. (紅外溫度計和紅外傳感器都不必與人的皮膚接觸。)
Invasive (adj.)moving into all areas of something and difficult to stop 侵襲
的，侵入的
They treated the cancer with non-invasive methods/surgery.

questions.stem: Peloton has been called the Amazon, the Apple, and the Netflix of the fitness industry. With such comparisons, you would be right in assuming that Peloton is an incredibly successful business. In a short time, the American company has sold hundreds of thousands of stationary bikes to enthusiastic customers. However, these aren't your typical workout bikes. The exercise equipment comes with an attached computer screen that you can use to watch fitness classes. Peloton also offers treadmills with built-in tablets. Who most likely would become a customer of Peloton?

options.A: A person who enjoys going to a gym.
options.B: A person who likes to watch movies.
options.C: A person who enjoys hanging out with friends.
options.D: A person who likes to play chess.

questions.explain:
解析: 題目問誰最有可能成為Peloton的客戶？依照 文中 ”Peloton被稱為健身
行業的亞馬遜，蘋果和Netflix。” 答案a 一個喜歡去健身房的人。
